capabilities: Generate a continuous multi-year calendar in one Markdown file
Add inline records with tags, wikilinks, and date ranges
Jump to today or any date via commands and a sidebar outline
Show per-tag statistics, activity heatmaps, timelines, and yearly summaries
Migrate legacy nested calendar formats to the current inline format
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns users to back up the calendar file before running overwrite or migration commands, and beta installation via BRAT is described.
problem: Obsidian daily notes create one file per day, but some users want all dated records for many years kept and analyzed in one Markdown document.
summary: Multi-year calendar ledger that stores dated records, tags, wikilinks, and date ranges in a single Markdown file with sidebar stats, heatmaps, and yearly summaries.
